run_dpo_training: run DPO fine-tuning on Gemma 3 4B using kauldron with the argilla math preference dataset
configure_anchored_policy: configure an AnchoredPolicy wrapping Gemma3_4B with a frozen reference model for DPO training
setup_dpo_loss: set up DpoLoss using policy and anchor logits to optimize preferred responses over rejected ones
create_dpo_dataset_pipeline: create a HuggingFace data pipeline with ContrastiveTask transforms for chosen and rejected response pairs
load_checkpoint_for_dpo: load pretrained Gemma 3 4B checkpoint weights using AnchoredPolicyLoader for DPO fine-tuning
